seoTitle: Change Namecheap Nameservers for Another Hosting Service
metaDescription: Connecting your Namecheap domain to Hostinger, Bluehost, SiteGround, or another host? Learn how to update nameservers correctly and confirm propagation.
intro: Pointing a Namecheap domain to a different hosting provider usually comes down to updating the nameservers rather than editing individual DNS records. This guide covers accessing your domain settings, replacing the default nameservers with your host's values, and confirming the change takes effect.

steps.heading: Access your domain settings in Namecheap
steps.body: Log in to the Namecheap dashboard and open the domain you want to point to a new hosting provider.

steps.heading: Find your hosting provider's nameserver details
steps.body: Get the nameserver values from your hosting provider, whether that's Hostinger, Bluehost, SiteGround, or another host.

steps.heading: Replace the default nameservers
steps.body: In Namecheap, swap out the existing nameservers for the ones supplied by your new hosting provider.

steps.heading: Save the changes
steps.body: Confirm and save the updated nameservers so Namecheap begins directing DNS management to your new host.

steps.heading: Confirm propagation and connection
steps.body: Allow time for propagation, then check that your domain now resolves to your new hosting provider's server.

faq.question: How is changing nameservers different from editing DNS records?
faq.answer: Changing nameservers hands over all DNS management to the new host, while editing individual records keeps management within Namecheap.

faq.question: Will my email break if I change nameservers?
faq.answer: It can, so you may need to recreate MX records with your new hosting provider to keep email working after the switch.

faq.question: Does this method work for any hosting provider?
faq.answer: Yes, this approach works broadly for platforms like Hostinger, Bluehost, SiteGround, or any other hosting service that provides its own nameservers.

faq.question: How long until my site loads on the new host?
faq.answer: It depends on propagation, which typically ranges from minutes up to about 24-48 hours.
